title: Stasis Forge
description: A woman in a striped dress sits in a wooden rowboat on dark water, holding a small mirror up towards a giant ornate skull floating in the night sky. The skull is adorned with vibrant flowers, vines, and glowing orange light beams from its eyes, set against a starry sky with aurora borealis and a dark forest silhouette in the background.
prompt: A woman in a black and teal striped off-shoulder dress sits in a wooden rowboat on dark water, holding up a small hand mirror towards a massive ornate white skull floating in the night sky. The skull is covered in vibrant red, orange, and blue flowers with green vines and leaves growing from it. Beams of orange light shine from the skull's eyes. Background features a dark forest silhouette, starry sky, and swirling teal and blue aurora borealis. Mystical fantasy style with glowing orbs and intricate details.
